description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional responses, likely from a study evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different emotion. The “Neutral” category is represented by a blue slice and accounts for approximately 23.1% of the total. A light blue slice labeled “Frustration” represents 25.1%. The “Anger” category is shown as a yellow slice, comprising roughly 14.9%, while “Sadness” is represented by an orange slice at approximately 14.1%. A red slice indicates “Happiness” at 8.1%, and “Excitement” is shown as a peach-colored slice representing 14.1%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each emotion. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with “Neutral” and generally descending in size.
